project.title: The Boy Who Found a Magic Robot
project.instructions: Create an original cartoon with consistent character designs, detailed facial expressions, full-body movements, realistic reactions, synchronized dialogue, sound effects, and cinematic camera movements.

characters.name: Jay

appearance.clothing: Blue hoodie, black trousers, white sneakers

facial_expressions.happy: Wide smile, raised cheeks, bright eyes
facial_expressions.sad: Drooping eyebrows, lowered head, trembling lips
facial_expressions.angry: Furrowed eyebrows, narrowed eyes, tight lips
facial_expressions.surprised: Raised eyebrows, enlarged pupils, open mouth
facial_expressions.scared: Wide eyes, trembling lips, tense face
facial_expressions.confused: Tilted head, one raised eyebrow, pursed lips
facial_expressions.laughing: Closed or squinting eyes, open smiling mouth, shaking shoulders

body_movements: Walk naturally with alternating arm and leg movements

characters.name: Beep

appearance.details: Blue accents, glowing cyan eyes, tiny mechanical arms, wheels

facial_expressions.happy: Curved cyan eyes and a smiling digital mouth
facial_expressions.sad: Drooping eye shapes and a small frown
facial_expressions.angry: Narrow glowing eyes and a straight digital mouth
facial_expressions.surprised: Large circular eyes and an open digital mouth
facial_expressions.scared: Rapidly blinking eyes and a trembling body
facial_expressions.confused: Uneven eye shapes and a tilted head
facial_expressions.thinking: Focused eyes with a slowly rotating head

body_movements: Roll forward and backward on wheels
Extend mechanical arms when helping someone

characters.name: Mystery Cat

facial_expressions.mischievous: Narrowed eyes and a slightly raised head

body_movements: Walk with a gently swaying tail

scenes.title: The Mysterious Box
camera: Begin with a wide aerial shot of the park
Slowly zoom toward Jay
Cut to a close-up of Jay's face
Finish with a close-up of the metallic box

actions.action: Walk along the park path while kicking a small pebble
actions.body_movement: Natural walking cycle with swinging arms

actions.action: Notice a mysterious metallic box under a tree
actions.facial_expression: Eyebrows rise, pupils enlarge, mouth opens slightly
actions.body_movement: Stop walking, lean forward, bend knees

actions.action: Look around and slowly touch the box
actions.body_movement: Turn head left and right before reaching forward

actions.action: Jump backward when the box starts shaking
actions.body_movement: Raise both arms and jump backward

scenes.transition: A bright blue flash reveals the next scene

scenes.title: The Robot Wakes Up
camera: Extreme close-up of the box opening
Slow reveal of glowing robot eyes
Medium shot of Jay and Beep
Close-up of Jay laughing

actions.action: Rise from the box and activate its glowing eyes
actions.facial_expression: Eyes blink three times before forming a smile
actions.body_movement: Head rises slowly and rotates from side to side

actions.action: Roll forward and bump gently into Jay's shoe
actions.body_movement: Roll forward, stop suddenly, tilt head upward

actions.action: Stare at the robot in disbelief
actions.body_movement: Lean backward and point toward Beep

actions.action: Burst into laughter
actions.facial_expression: Squinting eyes and a wide smile
actions.body_movement: Bend forward and hold stomach

actions.action: Tilt head in confusion
actions.facial_expression: Uneven digital eyes and confused mouth
actions.body_movement: Rotate head slowly

dialogue.text: INCORRECT. MAIN EK VERY HANDSOME TOASTER HOON!

scenes.transition: Camera pans toward a football near a park bench

scenes.title: The Robot's First Superpower
camera: Medium shot of Jay pointing at a football
Tracking shot following Beep
Fast cuts showing flying metal objects
Close-up of Beep's spinning head

actions.action: Point toward a football
actions.body_movement: Extend right arm and point

actions.action: Activate a magnetic beam
actions.facial_expression: Focused eyes that turn red when the power malfunctions
actions.body_movement: Extend one arm and vibrate rapidly

actions.action: Metal objects begin flying toward Beep
actions.visual_effects: Blue magnetic energy waves and flying keys

actions.action: Dodge flying objects and shout at Beep
actions.facial_expression: Wide eyes, raised eyebrows, open mouth
actions.body_movement: Duck, sidestep, and wave both arms

actions.action: Get hit gently by the football
actions.body_movement: Head spins around while wheels stop

dialogue.text: Beep, kya tum us ball ko mere paas la sakte ho?

scenes.transition: A cat's loud meow interrupts the scene

scenes.title: The Cat Attack
camera: Close-up of the orange cat
Low-angle shot as the cat jumps
Circular tracking shot following Beep
Wide shot of the chase

actions.action: Approach Beep and jump onto its head
actions.facial_expression: Curious eyes changing into a mischievous expression
actions.body_movement: Crouch, jump, land gently, and sit

actions.action: Freeze after detecting the cat
actions.facial_expression: Giant circular eyes and a trembling digital mouth
actions.body_movement: Stop wheels and slowly turn head toward Jay

actions.action: Roll backward in fright
actions.body_movement: Spin in circles and accelerate away

actions.action: Chase Beep playfully
actions.body_movement: Run with tail raised and make small sideways jumps

actions.action: Run behind the robot while laughing
actions.body_movement: Run with swinging arms

scenes.transition: The chase stops when a child cries nearby

scenes.title: The Unexpected Hero
camera: Close-up of a colorful kite stuck in a tree
Close-up of the crying child
Medium shot of Jay and Beep
Low-angle shot during the rescue
Wide shot of the reunited child and kite

actions.action: Look up at a kite stuck in a tree and begin crying
actions.body_movement: Lower shoulders and reach toward the kite

actions.action: Stop laughing and approach the child
actions.facial_expression: Concerned eyes and a gentle smile
actions.body_movement: Turn toward the child and kneel slightly

actions.action: Activate hero mode
actions.facial_expression: Bright glowing blue eyes and confident digital smile
actions.body_movement: Straighten body and extend mechanical arms

actions.action: Raise Jay safely toward the kite using a small platform
actions.body_movement: Remain stable while slowly lifting the platform

actions.action: Carefully remove the kite and hand it to the child
actions.body_movement: Reach toward the branch and gently pass the kite down

actions.action: Receive the kite and smile
actions.facial_expression: Happy eyes and a wide smile
actions.body_movement: Hug the kite and jump with excitement

dialogue.text: Meri kite! Koi meri help karo!
Beep, ab humein kisi ki help karni hai.

scenes.transition: Warm sunset light fills the screen

scenes.title: A New Adventure
camera: Tracking shot of Jay and Beep walking together
Close-up of Jay asking a question
Close-up of Beep's glowing eyes
Wide cinematic shot of the characters running into the sunset

actions.action: Walk beside Beep and ask about tomorrow
actions.body_movement: Walk naturally while looking toward Beep

actions.action: Announce a plan to conquer the moon
actions.body_movement: Raise both arms and accelerate forward

actions.action: Stop suddenly and react with surprise
actions.body_movement: Freeze briefly and then run after Beep

actions.action: Follow Jay and Beep while carrying the stolen antenna cover
actions.body_movement: Run with tail raised

dialogue.text: Beep, kal hum kya adventure karenge?

ending.visual: Camera rises above the park as the three characters disappear into the orange-purple sunset

global_animation_rules.character_consistency: Keep each character's face, clothing, proportions, colours, and identifying features consistent across all scenes.
global_animation_rules.facial_animation: Animate eyebrows, eyelids, pupils, mouth shapes, cheeks, and head tilts according to each emotion.
global_animation_rules.lip_sync: Synchronize mouth movements with spoken dialogue and syllables.
global_animation_rules.body_animation: Use anticipation, acceleration, follow-through, and settling movements for believable cartoon actions.
global_animation_rules.eye_tracking: Characters must look toward the person or object they are interacting with.
global_animation_rules.camera: Use wide shots for locations, medium shots for interactions, close-ups for emotions, and tracking shots for movement.
global_animation_rules.lighting: Use cinematic lighting, soft shadows, and colourful environments.
global_animation_rules.audio: Synchronize dialogue, sound effects, and background music with the action.
global_animation_rules.transitions: Use smooth cinematic cuts, pans, or magical transitions.
global_animation_rules.quality_control: Avoid distorted faces, extra limbs, inconsistent clothing, sudden character redesigns, and unnatural motion.
global_animation_rules.storytelling: Every scene must have a clear beginning, action, reaction, and conclusion.
